title: 第17章 老子要杀的人没人能拦得住第18章 天命帝族的强势杀到你无路可退
slug: 被问罪当天无上帝族杀来
content_zh:
“你在找死！”
无尽的震怒夹带着天威从半空炸落，整个战场尽数炸成满天的粉尘。
那浩浩的威压化作冰冷的杀机，尽数朝叶沉雁所在压下。
无疑，龙擎北对陈霸道已经产生了杀意。
当着他的面杀他的弟弟。
无视他的警示，那就是死罪。
他龙擎北之威，更不容挑衅。
“想杀老子？你也差远了。”
陈霸道周身力量炸起，万丈天雷快速奔走。
一尊雷帝躯体擎天而起，遍身的雷系法则在解封，天地刹间布满了肃杀。
雷声如战鼓，融入天地间，天地跟着雷鼓在伏动，在咆哮。
雷神战锤。
战天地，镇万古！
陈霸道猛然化身雷神，手持天地雷锤，对着半空狠狠地锤落。
整个半空像是一片平静汪海，轰然炸起惊涛骇浪来，无尽的雷髓在上面暴走。
刹时间，那降落的天威被一锤打爆，连同无限的虚空也被一锤打穿了。
现场的众人，通过被打穿的天地空间，看到了一尊阴沉至极的人影。
这人，正是龙擎北
这……好生可怕啊。
一锤打穿界域屏壁，直达亿万僵域外的上界。

姜太初等人的世界观再一次被刷新。
陈无敌也曾隔着百万僵域一手捏爆了太一道宫。
但对比于陈霸道来，只能说小巫见大巫，真的差远了。
我这便宜老爹，牛逼大了呀。
陈稳无法用言语来形容自己的心情，更无法用词语来形容自家老爹的强大。
什么叫底气。
这就是。
什么叫霸气。
这就是。
什么叫无敌。
这就是。
“好一个陈霸道，你这是在自取灭亡。”
龙擎北的震怒声再次响起。
“藏头缩尾的小丑，给老子滚出来。”
陈霸道大吼间，周身帝纹释放，古老的力量泄荡而出。
content_en:
"You're looking for death!"
Endless rage and the power of Heaven exploded from mid-air, and the entire battlefield exploded into dust all over the sky.
The vast coercion turned into cold murderous intent, pressing down on Ye Chenyan's location.
There is no doubt that Long Qingbei has murderous intentions towards Chen Badao.
Kill his brother in front of him.
Ignoring his warnings is a capital offense.
He is so powerful that he cannot be provoked.
"Want to kill me? You're not even close."
Chen Badao's whole body exploded with strength, and the thunder from the sky ran quickly.
The body of a Thunder Emperor rose into the sky, the laws of thunder all over his body were unsealing, and the world was filled with killing in an instant.
The sound of thunder is like a war drum, blending into the heaven and earth. The heaven and earth are moving and roaring with the thunder drum.
Thor's Warhammer.
Fight the world and conquer the world forever!
Chen Badao suddenly transformed into the God of Thunder, holding the thunder hammer of heaven and earth, and struck it down hard in the air.
The entire mid-air was like a calm sea, and violent waves suddenly exploded, with endless thunder marrow running rampant on it.
In an instant, the descending Tianwei was exploded by a hammer, and the infinite void was also penetrated by the hammer.
Everyone at the scene saw an extremely gloomy figure through the pierced space of heaven and earth.
This person is none other than Long Qingbei
This... is so scary.
With one hammer, he penetrated the boundary wall and reached the upper boundary beyond the billions of zombies.
The worldview of Jiang Taichu and others was once again refreshed.
Chen Wudi once crushed the Taiyi Palace with one hand across a million dead zones.
But compared to Chen Ba Dao, it can only be said that it is really far from being a big witch.
My cheap dad is so awesome.
Chen Wen couldn't use words to describe his feelings, let alone how powerful his father was.
What is confidence?
That's it.
What is domineering.
That's it.
What is invincibility?
That's it.
"What a Chen Ba Dao, you are asking for your own destruction."
Long Qingbei's angry voice sounded again.
"Get out of here, you clowning clown."
As Chen Badao roared, the imperial patterns all over his body were released, and the ancient power came out.
